text:
ITEM 1 | Short tube-shaped pasta pieces (penne-like), pale golden-beige with smooth glossy surface, some with ridges, roughly 3-4 cm long and 1 cm wide, scattered in a loose pile on the left third of the plate and partly coated in brown sauce; occupies about 25% of plate footprint, piled 1-1.5 cm high | 150

ITEM 2 | Sliced meat pieces in brown sauce, pale tan to darker brown edges with a slightly browned, matte-to-glossy surface, irregular chunks about 3-5 cm across and 1 cm thick, layered over and between the pasta on the left side; moist and clinging to sauce, covering about 20% of plate footprint | 120

ITEM 3 | Creamy brown sauce, smooth and slightly glossy, pooled around the meat and pasta with a thin film on the plate edge and a small dollop near the top left; semi-fluid, coats surfaces | 25

ITEM 4 | Fresh spinach leaves, dark green, flat and glossy with visible veins, mostly whole leaves about 6-10 cm long, loosely piled and slightly wilted with a light dressing sheen, covering about 20% of plate footprint on the right side, 1-2 cm high | 60

ITEM 5 | Broccoli florets, bright green with small dense buds, about 2-3 cm across, scattered among the greens on the right side; firm, slightly moist surface | 35

ITEM 6 | Orange bell pepper strips, bright orange with thin soft edges, about 4-5 cm long and 0.5 cm wide, scattered in small clusters among the greens; slightly glossy, moist | 20

ITEM 7 | Hard-boiled egg white wedge, pale white and smooth with a slight sheen, about 4 cm long and 2 cm wide, one visible piece near the center-right of the salad; firm and matte | 15

ITEM 8 | Light vinaigrette-style dressing, thin, clear to pale yellowish film with slight sheen on the salad leaves and plate surface; spread thinly, flowing | 8
